verses.text: A song of ascents. By David. I was so glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”
And here we are, Jerusalem, standing inside your gates!
Jerusalem is built like a city held tightly together.
The tribes go up there, the LORD’s own tribes, to thank the LORD by name, just as Israel was told.
That’s where the thrones for judgment stand, the thrones of David’s family.
Pray for Jerusalem’s peace. May everyone who loves you thrive.
May there be peace inside your walls and well-being in your palaces.
For my family and friends, I’ll say, “May peace be within you.”
For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I’ll work for your good.
